Title: D1: Keep ModelContextProtocol NuGet Package
Content: Decision D1 (locked, 2026-06-01): Keep the ModelContextProtocol NuGet package. Do NOT replace with a hand-rolled McpController. Layer the tool catalog and risk model on top of the NuGet package's attribute-based system ([McpServerTool], [McpServerToolType] attributes). SplitBrainToolCatalog wraps the NuGet tools rather than replacing them. This was confirmed after comparing with MemorySmith's hand-rolled approach — the NuGet package's attribute model is simpler and more maintainable.
